answer: Save the low watermark: the position just past the last record in the unbroken run of finished records, so everything before it is done and the earliest unfinished record is still ahead of it. Saving the highest finished position instead skips any unfinished records below it for good if a crash happens, since restart resumes past them, so you lose data (at-most-once behavior). The safe point costs replay: records finished out of order above the watermark get processed again after a restart, so the sink must be idempotent. (pa_pattern_idempotency.md, L309-345)
